content: Spec Kit writes plan artifacts into the repo and can convert tasks to GitHub issues. A community Linear extension treats no local specs directory plus idempotent update-in-place as the point of an external tracker. Cursor-Linear assigns existing issues to the agent and syncs progress and PRs back; it does not invent a graph from a pre-prompt planner. Blocking the user until the tracker succeeds is a planning-product choice, not a host-bridge requirement. Fail-open plus idempotent external rows is the v1 for this seam.
